reset_fee: No reset of a live account; 'Retry' after breach gives a 20% discount code to repurchase (1-Step & 2-Step; 0% on Instant)
refund_policy: Refund available within 14 days if no simulated trade placed; traded accounts not refundable. No challenge-fee refund on pass for new programs (since 7 Feb 2026); legacy programs had fee refund at 10% profit.
time_limit: Unlimited (account breached if no trade in any 30-day period)
min_payout: $50 (1-Step, Instant, Activation Accounts); 1% of initial balance (2-Step); Activation Accounts also require ≥3% profit to be eligible
scaling_plan: 1-Step/Instant: +10% closed-balance profit per level, scale to $2.5M (to $5M with Scaling add-on); 2-Step: 20% profit + ≥1 payout + 2 months per level, to $2.5M; Activation Accounts: no scaling
max_risk_per_trade: No fixed per-trade cap; 2-Step has 3% symbol loss limit (hard breach); margin-utilisation risk-review triggers 50-75% by account size
inactivity_rule: Must open and close at least one trade every 30 days or account is breached (7-day email warning once)
notes: One-time fees, no subscription. Standard (pay-upfront) programs have no activation fee; Activation Accounts (Pass Now Pay Later) charge $4 upfront then an activation fee on pass of $179/$299/$489 for 25K/50K/100K (must pay within 60 days). EAs/algos allowed but no arbitrage, grid trading, tick scalping or other abuse; no support for EAs. Copy trading only between your own accounts (Traders Connect suggested); cross-trader copying and cross-account hedging banned; same-account hedging allowed. KYC via Sumsub at FT+ Trader stage, must be completed within 3 days. Payouts via crypto or Rise; FT+ may refund to card at its discretion. Swap-free on all programs.
